title: VEED hosted services (transcription, background removal, lipsync, AI presenter, fal models)
what_it_does: The CLI also calls VEED's cloud for best-quality transcription, background removal, lipsync and AI presenters, behind a login; free tier is about 10 minutes of transcription a month.
when_to_use: Only if the person already has a VEED account.
why: Paid or login-gated; the local WhisperX option inside it is not better than whisper.cpp which we already name.
